stem: Republic Act No. 9003 is known as the:
choices: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000
explanation: Section 1 of RA 9003 gives its short title as the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000.
quote: This Act shall be known as the "Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000."

stem: Republic Act No. 8749 is known as the:
choices: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000
explanation: Section 1 of RA 8749 gives its short title as the Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999.
quote: This Act shall be known as the "Philippine Clean Air Act of 1999."

stem: Republic Act No. 9275 is known as the:
choices: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000
explanation: Section 1 of RA 9275 gives its short title as the Philippine Clean Water Act of 2004.
quote: This Act shall be known as the "Philippine Clean Water Act of 2004."

stem: Republic Act No. 9729 is known as the:
explanation: Section 1 of RA 9729 gives its title as the Climate Change Act of 2009.
quote: This Act shall be known as the "Climate Change Act of 2009".

stem: Under RA 9003, within five years of the law's effectivity, each LGU must divert at least what share of its solid waste from disposal facilities through re-use, recycling and composting?
explanation: Section 20 of RA 9003 requires each LGU to divert at least 25% of all solid waste from waste disposal facilities within five years, with targets increasing every three years after.
quote: the LGU shall divert at least 25% of all solid waste from waste disposal facilities through re-use, recycling and composting activities

stem: Under RA 9003, segregation of solid wastes shall primarily be conducted:
choices: at the materials recovery facility only
explanation: Section 21 provides that segregation of wastes shall primarily be conducted at the source, including household, institutional, industrial, commercial and agricultural sources.
quote: segregation of wastes shall primarily be conducted at the source, to include household, institutional, industrial, commercial and agricultural sources

stem: Under RA 9003, a Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) shall be established in:
choices: every barangay or cluster of barangays
explanation: Section 32 requires a Materials Recovery Facility in every barangay or cluster of barangays.
quote: There shall be established a Materials Recovery Facility (MRF) in every barangay or cluster of barangays.

stem: Under RA 9003, within how many years after the law's effectivity must every LGU convert its open dumps into controlled dumps?
explanation: Section 37 prohibits open dumps and required every LGU to convert its open dumps into controlled dumps within three (3) years after the law took effect.
quote: within three (3) years after the effectivity of this Act, every LGU shall convert its open dumps into controlled dumps

stem: Which of the following is a prohibited act under RA 9003?
choices: The open burning of solid waste
Bringing recyclables to a junk shop
explanation: Section 48 of RA 9003 lists prohibited acts, including the open burning of solid waste and littering in public places.
quote: The open burning of solid waste

stem: Throwing or dumping waste matter in canals, esteros, sidewalks or parks is prohibited under which law?
explanation: Section 48(1) of RA 9003 prohibits littering, throwing, dumping of waste matters in public places such as roads, sidewalks, canals, esteros or parks.
quote: Littering, throwing, dumping of waste matters in public places, such as roads, sidewalks, canals, esteros or parks

stem: Under RA 9003, the National Solid Waste Management Commission is placed under:
choices: the Department of the Interior and Local Government
explanation: Section 4 establishes the National Solid Waste Management Commission under the Office of the President.
quote: There is hereby established a National Solid Waste Management Commission, hereinafter referred to as the Commission, under the Office of the President.

stem: RA 9003 defines composting as the controlled decomposition of organic matter by:
explanation: Section 3(f) defines composting as the controlled decomposition of organic matter by micro-organisms, mainly bacteria and fungi, into a humus-like product.
quote: Composting shall refer to the controlled decomposition of organic matter by micro-organisms, mainly bacteria and fungi, into a humus-like product

stem: RA 9003 defines an "open dump" as a disposal area where solid wastes are:
choices: indiscriminately thrown or disposed of without due planning
explanation: Section 3(t) defines an open dump as a disposal area wherein solid wastes are indiscriminately thrown or disposed of without due planning and consideration for environmental and health standards.
quote: Open dump shall refer to a disposal area wherein the solid wastes are indiscriminately thrown or disposed of without due planning and consideration for environmental and Health standards

stem: The Clean Air Act defines incineration, which it bans, as the burning of:
choices: municipal, biomedical and hazardous waste that emits poisonous and toxic fumes
explanation: Section 20 of RA 8749 bans incineration, defined as the burning of municipal, biomedical and hazardous waste which emits poisonous and toxic fumes, with exceptions such as traditional small-scale "siga" and crematoria.
quote: Incineration, hereby defined as the burning of municipal, biomedical and hazardous waste, which process emits poisonous and toxic fumes is hereby prohibited

stem: Which of the following is EXEMPT from the Clean Air Act's ban on incineration?
choices: Burning of municipal garbage in a dumpsite
Burning of hospital waste in the open
explanation: Section 20 of RA 8749 exempts the traditional small-scale "siga", traditional agricultural, cultural, health and food-preparation practices, and crematoria.
quote: the prohibition shall not apply to traditional small-scale method of community/neighborhood sanitation "siga", traditional, agricultural, cultural, health, and food preparation and crematoria

stem: Under the Clean Air Act, smoking inside a public building or an enclosed public place, including public vehicles, is:
choices: prohibited, with implementation by the LGUs
explanation: Section 24 of RA 8749 prohibits smoking inside public buildings, enclosed public places and public vehicles, outside designated areas, and assigns implementation to the LGUs.
quote: This provision shall be implemented by the LGUs.

stem: Which right of citizens is the first listed under the Clean Air Act's recognition of rights?
choices: The right to free medical care
The right to breathe clean air
The right to own a vehicle
explanation: Section 4(a) of RA 8749 recognizes the right to breathe clean air.
quote: The right to breathe clean air

stem: The Clean Air Act recognizes the principle that:
choices: the State shoulders all clean-up costs
explanation: The declaration of policy of RA 8749 recognizes the principle that "polluters must pay".
quote: The State also recognizes the principle that "polluters must pay".

stem: Which agency is the lead agency for implementing and enforcing the Clean Air Act and the Clean Water Act?
choices: The Department of Public Works and Highways
The Department of Environment and Natural Resources
explanation: Both laws make "the Department" (DENR) the primary government agency responsible for implementation and enforcement (RA 8749, Sec. 34; RA 9275, Sec. 19).
quote: The Department shall be the primary government agency responsible for the implementation and enforcement of this Act unless otherwise provided herein.

stem: Under the Clean Water Act, water quality management areas are designated using physiographic units such as:
choices: watersheds, river basins or water resources regions
explanation: Section 5 of RA 9275 designates water quality management areas using physiographic units such as watershed, river basins or water resources regions.
quote: using appropriate physiographic units such as watershed, river basins or water resources regions

stem: Under the Clean Water Act, "septage" refers to:
choices: sludge produced on individual onsite wastewater disposal systems such as septic tanks
explanation: RA 9275 defines septage as the sludge produced on individual onsite wastewater disposal systems, principally septic tanks and cesspools.
quote: Septage - means the sludge produced on individual onsite wastewater disposal systems, principally septic tanks and cesspools.

stem: Under the Clean Water Act, a person who pollutes water bodies beyond the applicable standards is responsible for:
choices: reporting it to the barangay only
containing, removing and cleaning up the pollution
nothing, if the pollution was accidental
explanation: Section 16 of RA 9275 makes anyone who causes pollution in excess of standards responsible to contain, remove and clean up the pollution incident at their own expense.
quote: shall be responsible to contain, remove and clean-up any pollution incident

stem: Who serves as Chairperson of the Climate Change Commission under RA 9729?
choices: The Secretary of Science and Technology
The Secretary of Environment and Natural Resources
explanation: Section 5 of RA 9729 makes the President of the Republic the Chairperson, with three Commissioners appointed by the President.
quote: The Commission shall be composed of the President of the Republic of the Philippines who shall serve as the Chairperson, and three (3) Commissioners to be appointed by the President

stem: Under the Climate Change Act, which entities are the frontline agencies in formulating and implementing local climate change action plans?
explanation: Section 14 of RA 9729 makes LGUs the frontline agencies in the formulation, planning and implementation of climate change action plans in their areas.
quote: The LGUs shall be the frontline agencies in the formulation, planning and implementation of climate change action plans in their respective areas

stem: The Climate Change Act states that the State adopted which framework, espousing sustainable development?
explanation: Section 2 of RA 9729 states that the State has adopted the Philippine Agenda 21 framework which espouses sustainable development.
quote: the State has adopted the Philippine Agenda 21 framework which espouses sustainable development
